messages:
ivy-cs: Heads up 12h: Penumbra reserved pool warmup tomorrow 08:00 PT. Need quota bump, autoscale sanity, and a short loadtest. @ben-eng @raj-sre @toni-ops please claim. @sara-billing can you confirm billing note?

ben-eng: I9ll own the dry-run. Plan: 25r/s shadow 20m, then ramp to 180r/s over 10m. Model pinned to rdx-6b-stable.

sara-billing: One-off quota increase approved and visible. Posting invoice note to finance.

raj-sre: Autoscale suggestion: min=1 max=16 target_cpu=60 scale_cooldown=90s. Abort if p99 > 2s for 5m or 5xx > 3% for 2m. I9ll monitor 07:45-09:15 PT.

toni-ops: Load script ready: `./tools/load --rps 25 --dur 1200 --model rdx-6b-stable --scenario penumbra-warm`. CI job queued `ci/penumbra-warm.yaml`. Artifacts go to s3 when done.

ivy-cs: Quick pre-run checklist: billing visible, KMS, smoke test. Reply ack when green.

ben-eng: Priming done, smoke test ok. Starting shadow now.

toni-ops: Ramping to 180r/s. No model switches.

raj-sre: Observed p99 ~1.05s, errors 0.5%, replicas peaking at 9. All within guardrails.

toni-ops: Run complete. Artifacts: s3://redwood-warmups/penumbra/1755551212/{summary.csv,metrics.png}.

ben-eng: Post-run summary: requests 260k, p50 100ms, p90 310ms, p99 980ms, errors 0.6%, peak_replicas 9, avg_cpu 56%. Recommend final autoscale: min=2 max=12 target_cpu=62, short headroom +2 for 5m.

ivy-cs: Thanks team 12 RC at 09:30 PT to review and add to renewal enablement notes. Closing thread after RC. :white_check_mark:
